enchantments.tooltip: Alchemical Water Attunement: Attacks and offensive spells have a chance to inflict ten stacks of cold damage over time, fading one stack at a time. This effect has an internal cooldown.

Legendary Freezing Gale: This weapon is imbued with a frigid wrath. On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit this freezing power will be released, dealing damage to the target and all enemies near it for 30d6 + 90 cold damage. A successful Will save (DC 100) reduces this by half.
Insightful Resistance +6: Passive: +6 Insight bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +22 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
